title.zh: 对《国家国内税收法典》的修改
title.en: An Act to Amend Section One Hundred Ninety of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred Sixty-Six, as Amended, Otherwise Known as the National Internal Revenue Code
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section One Hundred Ninety of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred Sixty-Six, as Amended, Otherwise Known as the National Internal Revenue Code
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Điều 190 của Đạo luật Thịnh vượng chung số 466 (Bộ luật Thuế nội địa) như đã được sửa đổi
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมมาตรา 190 แห่งพระราชบัญญัติเครือรัฐที่ 466 (ประมวลรัษฎากร) ซึ่งแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมแล้ว
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Pasal 190 Undang-Undang Persemakmuran No. 466 (Kitab Undang-Undang Pajak Dalam Negeri) sebagaimana diubah
title.ms: Akta meminda Seksyen 190 Akta Komanwel No. 466 (Kanun Hasil Dalam Negeri) sebagaimana dipinda

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）
